flow.label: DB Schema & Docs QA
flow.name: taskflow_db_qa_template
flow.description: Grounded answers about schema and business calibers: verify table structures and definitions first, then compose a cited answer.

config.goal: Locate tables/columns/dictionary definitions relevant to the user's question: use sql_query for metadata only (table list, column types and comments, value distribution of enum columns; no full scans); if knowledge spaces are configured, retrieve business calibers and doc definitions with knowledge_retrieve. Output a semantic card: relevant tables and columns, caliber and dictionary explanations, source list (table/doc names). Do not answer the question itself.

Compose the answer from the upstream semantic card and retrieved sources: conclusion first, then bulleted evidence, each citing its source (table/doc name); numbers must come from upstream verification; say so when not found, never fabricate. At most 300 words.
